verdict.rationale: A Git forge could plausibly offer AI-agent governance, so this story applies to Gitea. The evidence pack never mentions enabling or disabling AI agents per organization or instance, nor allow/ask/deny tool policies. General user permissions and ACLs, admin-panel config, and the existence of an official MCP server are adjacent features and do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enable or disable AI agents per group or instance and set allow, ask, or deny policies for the tools they can use
